title: sales.order_fulfilled.v1
description: Emitted by sales-service (src/sales/sales.service.ts) only when a sales order passes the server-authoritative capital eligibility check (creditEligibilityStatus = APPROVED). Posts Dr Agent Wallet / Trading Capital Receivable (1210) / Cr Sales Revenue (4000). See docs/SDD.md §3.D.

event_id.description: Random per publish — idempotency for this posting is guaranteed by sales_orders.client_event_id at the outer createSalesOrder() call.

order_value.description: Sum of orderedQty * unitPrice across all order lines.
